description: CUDA ptxas evidence for PTX 9.3 extended-precision mad.cc and madc forms. Acceptance is syntax/target evidence only and does not prove runtime behavior.

frontend_scope.working_tree_scope: Read-only ptxas evidence; no frontend or runtime claim.

capture_notes: Every source is a complete PTX module and every negative isolates one incompatible instruction.
Priority omitted hi/lo cases are observational because the brace syntax does not state a default.
The CUDA 13.1 assembler reports support through PTX 9.1; PTX 9.3 rejection is tool_unavailable, not a frontend contract result.
All positive probes use PTX 8.0/sm_80, which is above documented family floors; no GPU execution was performed.

single_case_replay.description: From the repository root, replace CASE_ID with a recorded case ID. The command writes source_text to runs/CASE_ID/case.ptx and runs replay.argv in replay.working_directory.
single_case_replay.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, subprocess
j=json.load(open('docs/extended_precision_ptxas.json')); c=next(x for x in j['cases'] if x['id']=='CASE_ID'); wd=pathlib.Path(c['replay']['working_directory']); wd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); (wd/c['source_file']).write_text(c['source_text']); subprocess.run(c['replay']['argv'], cwd=wd, check=False)
PY
